status: Exploratory extension after earlier results; all candidates and decisions retained
target: Observed PP-NRS W0>=4 and measured W0-W12 decrease>=4
selection: Training-fold median imputation, standardization, SelectKBest(f_classif), L2 logistic; selector refitted inside every inner and outer training fit
clinical_inputs: Same10 baseline fields and adolescent-DLQI masking as fixed-three analysis
nested_compact_rule: For each k3/4/5/6 select C with lowest mean inner logloss. Take lowest overall loss and sample-SD(ddof1)/sqrt3 SE. Choose smallest k with loss<=best+SE, and its best C. Exact C ties prefer smaller C. k19 excluded from compact selection.
interpretation_of_1SE: Simplicity heuristic, not an equivalence/noninferiority test; inner folds are dependent
evaluation: Mean repetition-specific OOF metrics primary; averaged held-out probabilities separately for historical comparison
bootstrap_scope: Paired patient resampling retaining all saved repeats; conditional on fitted predictions and does not encompass previous project adaptation
primary_comparisons: clinical+selected panel minus matched clinical control
nested compact procedure minus ranked3 within branch
reporting_rule: Do not select a global outer-AUC winner as an unbiased fixed panel. Report all sizes, inner-selected size distribution, marker-selection frequencies, selected-input observation coverage, and fixed-three controls. Larger panel justified only by meaningful/stable discrimination and probability-error gains; no universal clinical AUC cutoff.
deployment_boundary: No particular final marker set independently validated; same-cohort panel and endpoint exploration remains; no outcomes imputed
